description: Egyptian property listings from Aqarmap for sale or rent, by property type and location (e.g. apartment in cairo, villa in alexandria, cairo/new-cairo): listing ID, title, type, price in EGP, area (m²), rooms, baths, floor, finish type, year built, full location path, address, listing kind (owner/broker/sponsored), payment method, last update, photo and URL; 22 per page plus the total count. Seller names and phones are not returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: Location slug path as in Aqarmap URLs, e.g. cairo, alexandria, cairo/new-cairo (required)

type.description: Property type slug, e.g. apartment, villa, chalet, duplex, land; default all types
